idea-plugin.name: GitLane
idea-plugin.description:
A streamlined, guarded Git workflow plugin for teams following the develop → YYYYMMDD_task → develop → master lane (or direct master → YYYYMMDD_task → master via useDevelopBranch: false). Works identically alongside the GitLane VS Code extension via a shared .gitlane.json repository configuration.

  • ① Start Task: Fast-forwards develop and creates a local-date YYYYMMDD_task branch with dirty-tree auto-stash protection.
  • ② Merge to develop: Verifies clean working tree and non-protected branch, merges with --no-ff, pushes, and optionally deletes the task branch.
  • ③ Release to master: Previews ahead commits before merging develop into master, pushes, and returns to develop.
  • Conflict Guardrails: Pauses safely on merge conflicts, opens IntelliJ's native 3-Way Merge dialog, and provides one-click completion or abort recovery.

팀 공용 초간단 Git 워크플로우 (develop → YYYYMMDD_작업명 → develop → master) 플러그인입니다.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• 0.2.1: Show conflict resolution actions (3-Way Merge, Complete Merge, Abort Merge) only while a merge conflict is in progress, keeping the GitLane menu clean during normal work.
  • 0.2.0: Added useDevelopBranch option (.gitlane.json) to support branching from and merging directly into master without a develop branch.
  • 0.1.1: Replaced deprecated AbstractVcsHelper.showMergeDialog with GitConflictResolver for full IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2+ compatibility.
  • 0.1.0: Initial release of GitLane with Start Task, Merge to develop, Release to master, native 3-Way Merge conflict workflow, and real-time Status Bar widget.
